adoration.text: Adoration room is open 6:00am to 10:15pm daily, closed every Wednesday from 10:00am to 12 noon for cleaning.

confession.text: Sacrament of Reconciliation is 30 minutes before Weekend Mass in the Main Church.

devotions.text: Rosary Prayers: Mon to Fri at 5:15pm in the Main Church.
Divine Mercy Devotion: Every Tue at 6:45pm in the Main Church.
Christian Meditation: Every Wed at 8:00pm in St John/St Luke room.

office_hours.text: Parish Office: Mon & Sat 9:00am–6:00pm; Tue to Fri 9:00am–8:00pm; Sun 9:00am–1:00pm; closed on public holidays.

good_to_know.text: Public holiday weekday Mass is at 8:00am only.
Columbarium visiting hours are extended to 10:00pm on 2 Nov.

events.title: Infant Baptism Preparation Session
events.text: Infant Baptism Preparation Session for parents and godparents at 14:00 at Verbist Hall. Registration closes 01 Nov at 12:00. Application form and required documents to be submitted to the Parish Secretary; no submission by email.

events.title: Beginning Experience (BE) Weekend
events.text: Beginning Experience (BE) Weekend, 13–15 Nov 2026, for the permanently separated, divorced or widowed (both males and females). Cost: $230. Registration or enquiries: https://www.besingapore.org/BE_Event.

events.title: OLPS 2026 Parish Conversations
events.text: OLPS 2026 Parish Conversations at Verbist Hall (Level 4), 19:00–21:30. Open to all OLPS parishioners. 19:00–19:45 light dinner and fellowship; 20:00 synodal dialogue. Register by 6 Nov 2026.

events.title: OLPS Family Weekend 2026
events.text: OLPS Family Weekend 2026, 21–22 Nov 2026 at St Stephen’s School. Open to families with children aged 7 to 21. Registration fee: $50 per family. Registration closes 6 Nov 2026. Enquiries: James @ 9880 2203 or familylife@olps.sg.
